A.definition: Fallback per-transit (depth/error)^2, partial-event inverse-variance attribution. Report cadence_matched_shifted_control fields; legacy shifted_control fields count off-data shifts as edges and are superseded.
A.shifted_control_rule: Random event shifts uniform ±6 d, redraw when no observed in-transit cadence; score same first/last observed-cadence edge mask; partial shifts weighted by in-transit inverse variance
A.legacy_control_definition: Fallback: sum per-transit (depth/error)^2 weighted by edge in-transit inverse variance; public pilot script unavailable. Shifted event midpoint ±6 d may leave orbit; outside is counted edge (documented conservative control).
